name: NVIDIA Canary-1B-v2
purpose: High-quality speech transcription and translation across 25 European languages in one 1B model; card lists word- and segment-level timestamps and permissive CC BY 4.0 licensing.

license.name: CC-BY-4.0
license.notes: HF tag cc-by-4.0, no LICENSE file in the repo; card: "ready for commercial/non-commercial use" and "permissive CC BY 4.0 license". CC BY 4.0 legal code read in the Fluid Speech Pro repo; attribution required.

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE encoder-decoder: FastConformer encoder (32 layers) + Transformer decoder (8 layers), 16,384-token SentencePiece vocabulary
architecture.why_this_design: Card: task-specific tokens (source and target language) steer one model for ASR and translation; widens the earlier 4-language Canary to 25 languages.

benchmarks.name: German WER, Open ASR multilingual track (6 of 8 datasets)
benchmarks.harness: Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, German column (WER %), read from the Space config JSON 2026-11-19; rows differ in how many of the 8 datasets they cover

benchmarks.name: Open ASR English avg WER (leaderboard rank 54 of 69)

strengths: timestamps and translation in one model
weaknesses: English average lower than Parakeet v2/v3 on the leaderboard (8.43 vs 7.04)
autoregressive decoder slower than TDT models

tona_fit.reason: CC-BY-4.0, 1B, fits every class; independent German 4.06 on par with Parakeet v3 (4.12), plus translation and timestamps. Cohere, Qwen3-ASR and Fluid are ahead on German; Tona has no audio module (blocker only).

open_questions: Own German comparison against parakeet-primeline and Cohere on German meeting audio
